papers.title: On the role of Model Uncertainties in Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular method for black-box optimization, which relies on uncertainty as part of its decision-making process when deciding which experiment to perform next. However, not much work has addressed the effect of uncertainty on the performance of the BO algorithm and to what extent calibrated uncertainties improve the ability to find the global optimum. In this work, we provide an extensive study of the relationship between the BO performance (regret) and uncertainty calibration for popular surrogate models and compare them across both synthetic and real-world experiments. Our results confirm that Gaussian Processes are strong surrogate models and that they tend to outperform other popular models. Our results further show a positive association between calibration error and regret, but interestingly, this association disappears when we control for the type of model in the analysis. We also studied the effect of re-calibration and demonstrate that it generally does not lead to improved regret. Finally, we provide theoretical justification for why uncertainty calibration might be difficult to combine with BO due to the small sample sizes commonly used.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究贝叶斯优化中的不确定性校准问题，对代理建模中的采样效率有间接参考价值，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on uncertainty calibration in Bayesian optimization without addressing constraints, FEA-based surrogate modeling, or biomechanical design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究模型不确定性如何影响贝叶斯优化性能及校准的作用
summary_zh.method: 比较流行代理模型，分析校准误差与后悔值之间的关联
summary_zh.result: 校准与后悔正相关在校正模型类型后消失，重新校准不改善优化表现
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和真实问题上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the impact of model uncertainties on Bayesian optimization performance and the role of uncertainty calibration.
summary_en.method: Compare popular surrogate models and analyze the relationship between calibration error and optimization regret.
summary_en.result: Positive association between calibration and regret disappears when controlling for model type; recalibration generally does not improve regret.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world experiments.

papers.title: Defect detection in laser powder bed fusion using coaxial melt pool monitoring
papers.abstract: Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) is the most widely used form of metal Additive Manufacturing (AM). Critical applications attempting to use metal AM include nuclear reactors, rockets, turbo-machinery and medical implants. Modern Design for AM enables high functionality, weight saving and even metamaterial properties. Furthermore no tooling is required, there is only a single production step and design may be changed based purely on software. However certification of structural integrity, essential for critical applications, presents a major problem. Traditional inspection methods such as X-ray Computed-Tomography are exorbitantly expensive, with inspection costs exceeding production costs. In-situ monitoring presents a solution by inspecting the part as it is built. While there are a wide variety of systems available none are proven to reliably detect defects in an industrial setting. This thesis aims to develop an in-situ monitoring system capable of economically detecting defects of concern to industry. The problem of defect detection was framed by determining the best metrics for measuring detection performance. Based on these metrics, the minimum viable performance for industry adoption was determined through consultation with industrial partners. To meet this standard, a system was designed to record coaxial melt pool images using a high speed streaming camera. This was chosen as it produces the largest volumes of data. While this made processing computationally intensive it maximised the volume of information available for detection. The outcome is a coaxial melt pool monitoring system which is capable of detecting (Probability of Detection (POD) = 0.8, Probability of False Alarm (PFA) = 0.1) small volumes of porosity (>0.2%) within localised regions (2mm voxels)...

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注LPBF过程中的缺陷监测，未涉及生物医用植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学性能，与本方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on in-situ defect detection during LPBF, with no discussion of porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, mechanical testing, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决LPBF关键应用中缺陷检测的可靠性和成本问题。
summary_zh.method: 设计同轴熔池高速摄像监测系统，基于熔池图像进行缺陷检测。
summary_zh.result: 系统能检测局部区域（2mm体素）内的小孔隙（>0.2%），检测概率0.8，虚警概率0.1。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与工业合作伙伴协商确定最低性能标准，并在实际系统中验证检测性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of reliable and cost-effective defect detection in critical applications of LPBF.
summary_en.method: A coaxial melt pool monitoring system using a high-speed streaming camera was designed to capture melt pool images for defect detection.
summary_en.result: The system achieved a probability of detection of 0.8 and a probability of false alarm of 0.1 for detecting porosity (>0.2%) within localized 2mm voxels.
summary_en.validation: The detection performance was validated against industry-defined minimum viable standards through consultation with industrial partners.

papers.title: Randomized Clinical Trial Comparing Insertion Torque and Implant Stability of Two Different Implant Macrogeometries in the Initial Periods of Osseointegration.
papers.abstract: Objectives: The present study compared two implants with different macrogeometries placed in healed alveolar sites, evaluating the insertion torque (ITV) and implant stability quotient (ISQ) values at three different periods. Methods: Seventy patients with a total of 100 dental implants were allocated into two groups (n = 50 per group): DuoCone implants (DC group) that included 28 implants in the maxilla and 22 in the mandible, and Maestro implants (MAE group) that included 26 in the maxilla and 24 in the mandible. The ITV was measured during the implant placement, and the ISQ values were measured immediately at implant placement (baseline) and after 30 and 45 days. Results: The mean and standard deviations of the ITV were statistically significant (p < 0.0001), 56.4 ± 6.41 Ncm for the DC group and 29.3 ± 9.65 Ncm for the MAE group. In the DC group, the ISQs ranged between 61.1 ± 3.78 and 69.8 ± 3.86, while the MAE group presented similar values compared with the other group, ranging between 61.9 ± 3.92 and 72.1 ± 2.37. Conclusions: The value of implant insertion torque did not influence the ISQ values measured immediately after implant placement. However, the ITV influenced the ISQ values measured in the two initial periods of osseointegration, with implants installed with lower torques presenting higher ISQ values.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为牙科植入物临床随机试验，未涉及增材制造或多孔结构，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical trial on dental implant macrogeometry and does not involve additive manufacturing, porous structures, mechanical testing, fatigue, or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较两种不同宏观几何形状的牙种植体在骨整合初期的插入扭矩和稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 对70名患者100颗种植体进行随机分组，测量ITV和ISQ值。
summary_zh.result: DuoCone组ITV显著高于Maestro组，但低扭矩种植体在初期ISQ更高。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随机对照试验，70名患者数据。

summary_en.motivation: To compare insertion torque and implant stability of two dental implant macrogeometries during early osseointegration.
summary_en.method: A randomized clinical trial with 70 patients and 100 implants, measuring ITV and ISQ at placement and after 30 and 45 days.
summary_en.result: DuoCone implants had higher insertion torque, but lower torque implants showed higher ISQ values at early time points.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation with human patients in a randomized trial.
